<!-- pr-reviewer: 80e8891e08a5675a8538667911c98a144dbbe7c3 -->
**Verdict: clean.** I found no blockers.

What I checked (read-only, against `origin/main` 7a626a7f5):

1. **Head and diff.** The PR head is `80e8891e0`. Its parent is `origin/main`. The diff changes 3 lines in `crates/app/tests/machine.rs` (605, 607, 614) and no other file.
2. **The new word is not a kind.** `crates/post/src/machine/kind.rs:93-111` (`Kind::from_word`) keeps only the alphanumeric characters and makes them lower case. "drill press" becomes "drillpress". No match arm has "drillpress", so `from_word` gives `None`. Line 102 shows that "router" is now a legal word for `Kind::Mill` (#3279). This is the cause of the red main.
3. **The refusal names the word.** `declared_kind` (`kind.rs:201-205`) formats the original word with `{w:?}`, not the normalised word. The message has `"drill press"` in quotes, so `err.contains("drill press")` is true.
4. **`is_sane` refuses the word.** `crates/post/src/machine/def.rs:295-297` calls `limits_sane`. Lines 317-320 require `Kind::from_word(w).is_some()` for a stated kind. Thus `kind: Some("drill press")` gives `is_sane() == false`.
5. **No assertion is weaker.** The test keeps the same five assertions with the same strength: the `parse_mch` refusal, the word in the message, the table refusal, the empty word, and the `is_sane` refusal. Only the illegal word changes.
6. **No other red test.** I searched `crates/` and `xtask/` on `origin/main` for "router" as a kind word. Only `crates/app/tests/router_kind.rs` uses it, and that test expects a legal word. No other test uses "router" as an illegal kind.
7. **PR body.** The body says what changed and the cause. It gives the readings and names the pinning test. It has a "Not exercised" section, a `Changelog: none` line, and ends with `Fixes #3337`. It states honestly that the quick gate did not complete (disk space) and that clippy did not run. A test-only change needs no changelog row.

Built: not built (read-only review); the author's readings are the pinning test and the full `machine` binary (1 passed; 33 passed).

Coordinator: this PR merges now. It is the fix for a red main (#3337).

- Class: no refresh. The head 80e8891e0 is on top of `origin/main` 7a626a7f5.
- Review: the read-only review in comment 7077533464 on this exact head (clean, not built).
- Gate: the author ran the pinning test (1 passed) and the full `machine` binary (33 passed) on this head. The quick gate did not complete; the diff is one test file and its binary ran in full. The post-merge gate runs the batch tier on the merge commit.
